title: OASIS CAP v1.2 Alert (BEACON emitted subset)
description: JSON representation of an OASIS Common Alerting Protocol v1.2 alert (urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:cap:1.2). BEACON produces + validates CAP (validate-before-emit); it does NOT perform live IPAWS origination (Constitution Art. XIII). status defaults to 'Draft' (CAP_EMIT_MODE=draft) and only reaches 'Actual' after human VERIFIER/EM approval (Art. XIII, ADR-010). This is a boundary serialization mapped from the canonical ALERT entity by the AlertSink/EdxlPort anti-corruption adapter (ADR-001).

identifier.description: CAP <identifier> — unique message id assigned by the sender. MUST NOT contain spaces, commas or restricted characters (< & ').

sender.description: CAP <sender> — identifier of the sender (CAP_SENDER config, e.g. an email/URI). MUST NOT contain spaces, commas or restricted characters.

sent.description: CAP <sent> — origination date/time in ISO 8601 with mandatory timezone offset (e.g. 2026-06-27T14:30:00-07:00).

status.description: CAP <status> — appropriate handling of the alert. BEACON restricts to Actual|Draft (Art. XIII); Draft is the validate-before-emit default. Full CAP enum also allows Exercise|System|Test.

msgType.description: CAP <msgType> — the nature of the alert message.

scope.description: CAP <scope> — the intended distribution of the alert.

source.description: CAP <source> — text identifying the source of the alert (optional).

restriction.description: CAP <restriction> — rule for limiting distribution (required when scope=Restricted).

addresses.description: CAP <addresses> — space-delimited recipient list (required when scope=Private).

code.description: CAP <code> — special handling codes (zero or more).

note.description: CAP <note> — additional context (e.g. rationale for status).

references.description: CAP <references> — space-delimited list of sender,identifier,sent triplets referenced by Update/Cancel.

incidents.description: CAP <incidents> — space-delimited list of referent incident ids (GLIDE id per ADR-010).

info.description: CAP <info> blocks — at least one is required for an actionable alert (CAP allows zero only for Ack/Error/Cancel).
CAP <info> — describes an anticipated or actual event in terms of urgency, severity and certainty.

language.description: CAP <language> — RFC 3066 language code; defaults to en-US.

category.description: CAP <category> — code(s) denoting the category of the event. At least one.

event.description: CAP <event> — text denoting the type of the subject event.

urgency.description: CAP <urgency> — time available to take responsive action.

severity.description: CAP <severity> — intensity of impact of the subject event.

audience.description: CAP <audience> — intended audience of the info block.

eventCode.description: CAP <eventCode> — system-specific event codes as valueName/value pairs.

effective.description: CAP <effective> — effective time of the info; ISO 8601 with timezone.

onset.description: CAP <onset> — expected onset of the subject event.

expires.description: CAP <expires> — expiry time of the info.

senderName.description: CAP <senderName> — human-readable name of the sending agency.

headline.description: CAP <headline> — brief human-readable headline (SHOULD be <= 160 chars).

description.description: CAP <description> — extended human-readable description of the hazard.

instruction.description: CAP <instruction> — recommended action for the target audience.

web.description: CAP <web> — full URL associated with additional information.

contact.description: CAP <contact> — contact for follow-up and confirmation.

parameter.description: CAP <parameter> — system-specific additional parameters as valueName/value pairs.

area.description: CAP <area> blocks — geographic targeting of the info.
CAP <area> — the affected area of the alert message.

areaDesc.description: CAP <areaDesc> — text description of the affected area.

polygon.description: CAP <polygon> — one or more WGS-84 polygons. Each polygon is a space-delimited string of 'lat,lon' coordinate pairs whose first and last point are identical (closed ring), minimum 4 points.

circle.description: CAP <circle> — one or more circles as 'lat,lon radiusKm'.

geocode.description: CAP <geocode> — geographic code(s) as valueName/value pairs (e.g. SAME/FIPS).

altitude.description: CAP <altitude> — specific or minimum altitude of the affected area (feet WGS-84).

ceiling.description: CAP <ceiling> — maximum altitude of the affected area (requires altitude).

namedValue.description: CAP valueName/value pair used by eventCode, parameter and geocode.
